data.name: Hurmuz
data.gender_notes: Hurmuz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hurma', meaning 'protection'. Often associated with a shining light. The name Hurmuz carries the meaning “Shining Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hurmuz usually hope their child will grow to embody shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Hurmuz signifies a beacon of light, guiding one through life's journey.
data.etymology: Hurmuz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hurmuz total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: هُرْمُز
in_arabic.meaning: هُرْمُز أسم فريد ومميز ومعناه العلامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: هُرْمُز أسم عربي قديم يذكر في القرآن الكريم في سورة القصص (34) في قصة فرعون، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى العلامة أو النصيحة، ويُعد من الأسماء الفريدة والنادرة، ويُعتبر من الأسماء التي لها تأثير جمالي وعلمي في ثقافة المسلمين

in_urdu.name: ہُرَمُز
in_urdu.meaning: ہُرَمُز ایک فریڈ اور ممیز نام ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے علامت اور مشورہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہُرَمُز ایک قدیم عربی نام ہے جو قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، سورة قصص (34) میں فرعون کی کہانی میں، اور اسے علامت یا مشورہ کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، یہ نام فریڈ اور نادر ہے، اور یہ نام المسلمین کی ثقافت میں جمالی اور علمي اثر ڈالتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हर्मूज़
in_hindi.meaning: हर्मूज़ एक विशिष्ट और अनोखा नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है संकेत या सलाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: हर्मूज़ एक पुराना अरबी नाम है जो कुरान में उल्लिखित है सुरह कसास (34) में, फिरौन की कहानी में, और इसे संकेत या सलाह के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम अद्वितीय और दुर्लभ है, और यह नाम मुस्लिम संस्कृति में कलात्मक और ज्ञानी प्रभाव डालता है

in_pashto.name: هُرْمُز
in_pashto.meaning: هُرْمُز یوڼه یوړلی او نومیړلی نوم دی، او دا یعنۍ نشانه

data.cultural_impact: The name Hurmuz has historical significance as it was once the name of a coastal province in ancient Iran, known for its strategic location and valuable ports. It is believed that the name may have inspired reverence and protection due to the importance of this region for trade and economy. Additionally, in the Persian epic poem "The Conference of the Birds," Hurmuz is mentioned as one of the sacred stops on the pilgrimage of the birds seeking the King of the Mountain, representing the spiritual quest of self-realization.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic context, the name Hurmuz holds spiritual significance as it evokes a sense of protection and security, often associated with Allah's unending mercy and compassion. The name connotes a shining light, a beacon of guidance, inspiring hope and courage during times of uncertainty. It is a reminder of the numerous blessings that Allah bestows upon us, and the importance of seeking his protection and guidance in all aspects of life. The name Hurmuz ultimately serves as a reminder of the divine presence that surrounds and protects us in times of need.
